different-component-name.strategy: fc.record({ theme: fc.string().filter((theme) => !theme.includes('.')), currentComponent: fc.string().filter((component) => !component.includes('.')), defaultComponent: fc.string().filter((component) => !component.includes('.')) }).filter(({ currentComponent, defaultComponent }) => currentComponent !== defaultComponent).map(({ theme, currentComponent, defaultComponent }) => ({ current: `${theme}.${currentComponent}`, themeDefault: `${theme}.${defaultComponent}` }))

different-theme-name.strategy: fc.record({ currentTheme: fc.string().filter((theme) => !theme.includes('.')), defaultTheme: fc.string().filter((theme) => !theme.includes('.')), component: fc.string().filter((component) => component.length > 0 && !component.includes('.')) }).filter(({ currentTheme, defaultTheme }) => currentTheme !== defaultTheme).map(({ currentTheme, defaultTheme, component }) => ({ current: `${currentTheme}.${component}`, themeDefault: `${defaultTheme}.${component}` }))

matching-split-parts.strategy: fc.record({ theme: fc.constantFrom('default', 'acme'), component: fc.string().filter((component) => component.length > 0 && !component.includes('.')) }).map(({ theme, component }) => ({ current: theme === 'default' ? component : `${theme}.${component}`, themeDefault: `${theme}.${component}` }))
